statement: On every connected admissible surface, an inclusion-kernel class in the fundamental group of the centralizer of an arbitrary homeomorphism subgroup is zero whenever it has a representative whose loop-generated closure in the ambient homeomorphism group, with its induced topology, is locally compact. The same holds for loops contained in any closed locally compact centralizer subgroup. A locally compact full centralizer therefore has injective inclusion on fundamental groups. On hyperbolic surfaces the ambient kernel condition is automatic.
depends_on: C33 and Pardon2013 Hilbert--Smith via the faithful product action on U times R; Borel1952 principal theorem with its unique continuous product coordinates; Haar averaging; the Koszul formula and Hopf--Rinow theorem; based universal-cover path lifting; C39 global contraction of ambient-null loops with commuting values
manuscript_passages: Section 23, folios 140-141, scans 279-281; Part C(b) infinite-operator request; exact inclusion map from the centralizer fundamental group to the H-invariant ambient fundamental group
depends_on_doubtful_reading: None. Borel's displayed product and definition of its notation were visually checked on page 271, and the semisimple-cover and general induction reductions were read in sections 3-4 on pages 277-278. No alteration of the subgroup topology is made.
notes: The actual loop-generated closure is closed in the ambient homeomorphism group, contained in the closed centralizer, and connected as the closure of a path-connected subgroup. Local compactness and its faithful action on the connected three-manifold U times R give a connected Lie group with precisely the induced topology. Borel's product map K times R^d to L supplies an explicit identity-fixing coordinate-scaling retraction. On the connected compact K, a bi-invariant metric pulls back to a geodesically complete metric on its universal cover; a geodesic to the lifted loop endpoint projects to a one-parameter loop with the same based homotopy class. All homotopies stay in the centralizer. C39 contracts this representative when its exact ambient class is zero. The general non-locally-compact closure case is not reduced and C12 remains Open.
